sourceRecords.title: Contract fixture for the state rule-pack contract; not an authority and not a jurisdiction
sourceRecords.publisher: Lifetime Tax Strategy Lab contract fixture
sourceRecords.retrievalNote: This is a CONTRACT FIXTURE, not a transcription of any authority. Every figure in this pack is invented for the purpose of exercising the contract's branches with known values. It declares the jurisdiction state:ZZ, which is not a jurisdiction, so this pack cannot resolve for any real household however its declared years are read, and its ruleStatus is user-hypothetical-law rather than enacted law. No figure here is, or may become, a figure in a shipped jurisdiction pack.

supportedFeatures.label: Fixture ordinary schedule pricing all supported income kinds
supportedFeatures.reason: The fixture declares preferentialPolicy none and carries a three-band ordinary schedule, so a pooled preferential amount is priced in the ordinary schedule with no engine branch.

supportedFeatures.label: Fixture surcharge leg and after-rate credit
supportedFeatures.reason: The fixture carries a threshold-set leg that does not vary by filing status and a credit applied after rate application to the ordinary leg only, so the application point and the applied-legs list are both exercised with known values.

unsupportedFeatures.label: Every provision this fixture does not carry
unsupportedFeatures.reason: A fixture carries exactly the branches it exists to exercise and nothing else. No result derived from it describes any real jurisdiction.
unsupportedFeatures.successorFeature: A real jurisdiction pack transcribed from that jurisdiction's own retrieved authority.

unsupportedFeatures.label: Any real jurisdiction
unsupportedFeatures.reason: The declared jurisdiction state:ZZ is not a jurisdiction, so this pack cannot resolve for a real household.

expiryPolicy.reason: A contract fixture does not expire because it transcribes no authority; it is replaced when the contract it exercises changes.
